title: Backstage Talent Scraper
description: Walks the Backstage Talent Database and saves each crew profile's link, name, and any contact links found. Remembers where it left off between runs.

startUrl.title: Backstage Talent Search URL
startUrl.description: Paste the exact Backstage talent search URL with your filters applied.

authState.title: Backstage Authentication State (optional)
authState.description: Leave blank to use the session already built into the actor. Only fill this in to run under a different session.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages This Run
maxPages.description: Stop this run after this many pages. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum Profiles This Run
maxProfiles.description: Stop this run after this many profiles. Use 0 for unlimited.
